correctness.rationale: The partial derivatives in characteristic 3 force x0=x1=x2=x3=0 at a simultaneous zero, establishing smoothness. Six disjoint reduced-row-echelon charts exhaust Grassmannian lines. Two charts are impossible and the other two principal families reduce to the separable additive degree-nine polynomials u^9±a^3u^3−u with exact free F3 coefficients; remaining charts give 4 fixed lines. At a=0 all roots lie in F9. At a≠0, Frobenius u↦u^3 satisfies the irreducible relation φ²±aφ−I=0 on a two-dimensional F3 root space, so φ^4=−I and its nonzero vectors have primitive period 8. Smooth quartic K3 line normal bundle O(-2) gives isolated reduced line scheme and finite étaleness; Galois cycles yield zeta factors. Independent elementary finite F3 quadratic action computation checked that nonzero vectors form one eight-cycle for both signs.
